passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
• It is located in Tanzania.
• Its summit is about 5,895 meters above sea level.
• Climbers can reach the summit without technical climbing equipment.
stem: The student wants to identify the country in which Mount Kilimanjaro is located. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Mount Kilimanjaro is located in Tanzania.
Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
Mount Kilimanjaro's summit is about 5,895 meters above sea level.
Climbers can reach Kilimanjaro's summit without technical equipment.
steps: The goal is to identify the country.
Only one note names a country: Tanzania.
The correct choice states it directly.
The other choices are true but give height, ranking or climbing information instead of the country.
key: Read the goal first, then find the note that matches it exactly.
